1.t: Alif-Lãm-Ra. ˹This is˺ a Book whose verses are well perfected and then fully explained. ˹It is˺ from the One ˹Who is˺ All-Wise, All-Aware
1.tr: Alif-Laaam-Raa; Kitaabun uhkimat Aayaatuhoo summa fussilat mil ladun Hakeemin Khabeer

2.t: ˹Tell them, O Prophet,˺ “Worship none but Allah. Surely I am a warner and deliverer of good news to you from Him
2.tr: Allaa ta'budooo illal laah; innanee lakum minhu nazeerunw Wa-basheer

3.t: And seek your Lord’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. He will grant you a good provision for an appointed term and graciously reward the doers of good. But if you turn away, then I truly fear for you the torment of a formidable Day
3.tr: Wa-anis taghfiroo Rabbakum summa toobooo ilaihi yumatti'kum mataa'an hasanan ilaaa ajalim musammanw Wa-yu'ti kulla zee fadlin fadlahoo Wa-in tawallaw fa-inneee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin Kabeer

4.t: To Allah is your return. And He is Most Capable of everything.”
4.tr: Ilal laahi marji'ukum Wa-Huwa 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer

5.t: Indeed, they enfold ˹what is in˺ their hearts, ˹trying˺ to hide it from Him! But even when they cover themselves with their clothes, He knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Surely He knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart
5.tr: Alaa innahum yasnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minh; alaa heena yastaghshoona siyaabahum ya'lamu maa yusirroona Wa-maa yu'linoon; innahoo 'aleemun bizaatis sudoor

6.t: There is no moving creature on earth whose provision is not guaranteed by Allah. And He knows where it lives and where it is laid to rest. All is ˹written˺ in a perfect Record
6.tr: Wa-maa min daaabbatin fil ardi illaa 'alal laahi rizquhaa Wa-ya'lamu mustaqarrahaa Wa-mustawda'ahaa; kullun fee Kitaabim Mubeen

7.t: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days—and His Throne was upon the waters—in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And if you ˹O Prophet˺ say, “Surely you will ˹all˺ be raised up after death,” the disbelievers will certainly say, “That is nothing but pure magic!”
7.tr: Wa-Huwal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati aiyaaminw Wa-kaana 'Arshuhoo alal maaa'i liyabluwakum aiyyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; Wa-la'in qulta innakum mab'oosoona min ba'dil mawti la-yaqoolannal lazeena kafaroo in haazaaa illaa sihrum mubeen

8.t: And if We delay their punishment until an appointed time, they will definitely say, “What is holding it back?” Indeed, on the Day it overtakes them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule
8.tr: Wala'in akharnaa 'anhumul 'azaaba ilaaa ummatim ma'doodatil la-yaqoolunna maa yahbisuh; alaa yawma ya'teehim laisa masroofan 'anhum Wa-haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

9.t: If We give people a taste of Our mercy then take it away from them, they become utterly desperate, ungrateful
9.tr: Wa-la'in azaqnal insaana minnaa rahmatan summa naza'naahaa minhu, innahoo laya'oosun kafoor

10.t: But if We give them a taste of prosperity after being touched with adversity, they say, “My ills are gone,” and become totally prideful and boastful
10.tr: Wala'in azaqnaahu na'maaa'a ba'da darraaa'a massat-hu la-yaqoolanna zahabas saiyiaatu 'anneee; innahoo lafarihun fakhoor

11.t: except those who patiently endure and do good. It is they who will have forgiveness and a mighty reward
11.tr: Illal lazeena sabaroo Wa-'amilus saalihaati ulaaa'ika lahum maghfiratunw Wa-ajrun kabeer

12.t: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ may wish to give up some of what is revealed to you and may be distressed by it because they say, “If only a treasure had been sent down to him, or an angel had come with him!” You are only a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of All Affairs
12.tr: Fala'allaka taarikum ba'da maa yoohaaa ilaika Wa-daaa'iqum bihee sadruka aien yaqooloo law-laaa unzila 'alaihi kanzun aw jaaa'a ma'ahoo malak; innamaa anta nazeer; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'inw wakeel

13.t: Or do they say, “He has fabricated this ˹Quran˺!”? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Produce ten fabricated sûrahs like it and seek help from whoever you can—other than Allah—if what you say is true!”
13.tr: Am yaqooloonaf taraahu qul faatoo bi'ashri Suwarim mislihee muftarayaatinw wad'oo manis tata'tum min doonil laahi in kuntum saadiqeen

14.t: But if your helpers fail you, then know that it has been revealed with the knowledge of Allah, and that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him! Will you ˹not˺ then submit ˹to Allah˺
14.tr: Fa-il-lam yastajeeboo lakum fa'lamooo annamaaa unzilla bi'ilmil laahi Wa-al laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fahal antum muslimoon

15.t: Whoever desires ˹only˺ this worldly life and its luxuries, We will pay them in full for their deeds in this life—nothing will be left out
15.tr: Man kaana yureedul hayaatad dunyaa zeenatahaa nuwaffi ilaihim a'maa-lahum feehaa Wa-hum feehaa laa yubkhasoon

16.t: It is they who will have nothing in the Hereafter except the Fire. Their efforts in this life will be fruitless and their deeds will be useless
16.tr: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena laisa lahum fil Aakhirati illan Naaru Wa-habita maa sana'oo feehaa Wa-baatilum maa kaanoo ya'maloon

17.t: ˹Can these people be compared to˺ those ˹believers˺ who stand on clear proof from their Lord, backed by ˹the Quran as˺ a witness from Him, and preceded by the Book of Moses ˹which was revealed˺ as a guide and mercy? It is those ˹believers˺ who have faith in it. But whoever from the ˹disbelieving˺ groups rejects it, the Fire will be their destiny. So do not be in doubt of it. It is certainly the truth from your Lord, but most people do not believe
17.tr: Afaman kaana 'ala baiyyinatim mir Rabbihee Wa-yatloohu shaahidum minhu Wa-min qablihee Kitaabu Moosaaa imaamanw Wa-rahmah; ulaaa-'ika yu'minoona bih; Wa-main yakfur bihee minal Ahzaabi fan-naaru maw'iduh; falaa taku fee miryatim minh; innahul haqqu mir Rabbika Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa yu'minoon

18.t: Who does more wrong than those who fabricate lies against Allah? They will be brought before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, “These are the ones who lied against their Lord.” Surely Allah’s condemnation is upon the wrongdoers
18.tr: Wa-man azlamu mimmanif taraa 'alal laahi kazibaa; ulaaa'ika yu'radoona 'alaa Rabbihim Wa-yaqoolul ashhaa duhaaa'ulaaa'il lazeena kazaboo 'alaa Rabbihim; alaa la'natul laahi alaz zaalimeen

19.t: who hinder ˹others˺ from Allah’s Path, striving to make it ˹appear˺ crooked, and disbelieve in the Hereafter
19.tr: Allazeena yasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi Wa-yabghoonahaa 'iwajanw Wa-hum bil Aakhiratihum kaafiroon

20.t: They will never frustrate Allah on earth, and they will have no protector besides Allah. Their punishment will be multiplied, for they failed to hear or see ˹the truth˺
20.tr: Ulaaa'ika lam yakoonoo mu'jizeena fil ardi Wa-maa kaana lahum min doonil laahi min awliyaaa'; yudaa'afu lahumul 'azaab; maa kaanoo yastatee'oonas sam'a Wa-maa kaanoo yubsiroon

21.t: It is they who have ruined themselves, and whatever ˹gods˺ they fabricated will fail them
21.tr: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasirooo anfusahum Wa-dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon

22.t: Without a doubt, they will be the worst losers in the Hereafter
22.tr: Laa jarama annahum fil Aakhirati humul akhsaroon

23.t: Surely those who believe, do good, and humble themselves before their Lord will be the residents of Paradise. They will be there forever
23.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati Wa-akhbatooo ilaa Rabbihim ulaaa'ika Ashaabul Jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon

24.t: The example of these two parties is that of the blind and the deaf, compared to the seeing and the hearing. Can the two be equal? Will you not then be mindful
24.tr: Masalul fareeqaini kal-a'maa wal-asammi walbaseeri wassamee'; hal yastawiyaani masalaa; afalaa tazakkaroon

25.t: Surely We sent Noah to his people. ˹He said,˺ “Indeed, I am sent to you with a clear warning
25.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee innee lakum nazeerum mubeen

26.t: that you should worship none but Allah. I truly fear for you the torment of a painful Day.”
26.tr: Al laa ta'budooo illal laaha inneee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin aleem

27.t: The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “We see you only as a human being like ourselves, and we see that no one follows you except the lowliest among us, who do so ˹hastily˺ without thinking. We do not see anything that makes ˹all of˺ you any better than us. In fact, we think you are liars.”
27.tr: Faqaalal mala-ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee ma naraaka illaa basharam mislanaa Wa-maa naraakat taba'aka illal lazeena hum araazilunaa baadiyar raayi Wa-maa naraa lakum 'alainaa min fadlim bal nazunnukum kaazibeen

28.t: He said, “O my people! Consider if I stand on a clear proof from my Lord and He has blessed me with a mercy from Himself, which you fail to see. Should we ˹then˺ force it on you against your will
28.tr: Qaala yaa-qawmi ara'aitum in kuntu 'alaa baiyyinatim mir Rabbee Wa-aataanee rahmatam min 'indihee fa'um-miyat 'alaikum anulzimuku-moohaa Wa-antum lahaa kaarihoon

29.t: O my people! I do not ask you for a payment for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from Allah. And I will never dismiss the believers, for they will surely meet their Lord. But I can see that you are a people acting ignorantly
29.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi laaa as'alukum 'alaihi maalan in ajriya illaa 'alal laah; Wa-maaa ana bitaaridil lazeena aamanoo; innahum mulaaqoo Rabbihim Wa-laakinneee araakum qawman tajhaloon

30.t: O my people! Who would protect me from Allah if I were to dismiss them? Will you not then be mindful
30.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi main yansurunee minal laahi in tarattuhum; afalaa tazak-karoon

31.t: I do not say to you that I possess Allah’s treasuries or know the unseen, nor do I claim to be an angel, nor do I say that Allah will never grant goodness to those you look down upon. Allah knows best what is ˹hidden˺ within them. ˹If I did,˺ then I would truly be one of the wrongdoers.”
31.tr: Wa-laa aqoolu lakum 'indee khazaa'inul laahi Wa-laaa a'lamul ghaiba Wa-laa aqoolu inee malakunw Wa-laaa aqoolu lillazeena tazdareee a'yunukum lai yu'tiyahumul laahu khairan Allaahu a'lamu bimaa feee anfusihim innee izal laminaz zaalimeen

32.t: They protested, “O Noah! You have argued with us far too much, so bring upon us what you threaten us with, if what you say is true.”
32.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Noohu qad jaadaltanaa fa-aksarta jidaalanaa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaaa in kunta minas saadiqeen

33.t: He responded, “It is Allah Who can bring it upon you if He wills, and then you will have no escape
33.tr: Qaala innamaa yaateekum bihil laahu in shaaa'a Wa-maaa antum bimu'jizeen

34.t: My advice will not benefit you—no matter how hard I try—if Allah wills ˹for˺ you to stray. He is your Lord, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.”
34.tr: Wa-laa yanfa'ukum nusheee in arattu an ansaha lakum in kaanal laahu yureedu aien yughwi-yakum; Huwa Rabbukum Wa-ilaihi turja'oon

35.t: Or do they say, “He has fabricated this ˹Quran˺!”? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If I have done so, then I bear the burden of that sin! But I am free from your sinful accusation.”
35.tr: Am yaqooloonaf taraahu qul inif taraituhoo fa'alaiya ijraamee Wa-ana bareee'um mimmaa tujrimoon

36.t: And it was revealed to Noah, “None of your people will believe except those who already have. So do not be distressed by what they have been doing
36.tr: Wa oohiya ilaa Noohin annahoo lany-yu'mina min qawmika illaa man qad aamana falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo yaf'aloon

37.t: And build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions, and do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
37.tr: Wasna'il fulka bi-a'yuninaa Wa-wahyinaa Wa-laa tukhaa-tibnee fil lazeena zalamoo; innahum mughraqoon

38.t: So he began to build the Ark, and whenever some of the chiefs of his people passed by, they mocked him. He said, “If you laugh at us, we will ˹soon˺ laugh at you similarly
38.tr: Wa-yasna'ul fulka Wa-kullamaa marra 'alaihi mala'um min qawmihee sakhiroo minh; qaala in taskharoo minnaa fa-innaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon

39.t: You will soon come to know who will be visited by a humiliating torment ˹in this life˺ and overwhelmed by an everlasting punishment ˹in the next˺.”
39.tr: Fasawfa ta'lamoona mai ya'teehi 'azaabuny yukhzeehi Wa-yahillu 'alaihi 'azaabun muqeem

40.t: And when Our command came and the oven burst ˹with water˺, We said ˹to Noah˺, “Take into the Ark a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed—and those who believe.” But none believed with him except for a few
40.tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa Wa-faarat tannooru qulnah mil feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini Wa-ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu Wa-man aaman; Wa-maaa aamana ma'ahooo illaa qaleel

41.t: And he said, “Board it! In the Name of Allah it will sail and cast anchor. Surely my Lord is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
41.tr: Wa-qaalar kaboo feehaa bismil laahi majraihaa Wa-mursaahaa; inna Rabbee la-Ghafoorur Raheem

42.t: And ˹so˺ the Ark sailed with them through waves like mountains. Noah called out to his son, who stood apart, “O my dear son! Come aboard with us and do not be with the disbelievers.”
42.tr: Wa-hiya tajree bihim fee mawjin kaljibaali Wa-naadaa Noohunib nahoo Wa-kaana fee ma'zilien yaa-bunai yarkam ma'anaa Wa-laa takum ma'al kaafireen

43.t: He replied, “I will take refuge on a mountain, which will protect me from the water.” Noah cried, “Today no one is protected from Allah’s decree except those to whom He shows mercy!” And the waves came between them, and his son was among the drowned
43.tr: Qaala sa-aaweee ilaa jabalien ya'simunee minal maaa'; qaala laa 'aasimal yawma min amril laahi illaa mar rahim; Wa-haala bainahumal mawju fakaana minal mughraqeen

44.t: And it was said, “O earth! Swallow up your water. And O sky! Withhold ˹your rain˺.” The floodwater receded and the decree was carried out. The Ark rested on Mount Judi, and it was said, “Away with the wrongdoing people!”
44.tr: Wa-qeela yaaa ardubla'ee maaa'aki Wa-yaa-samaaa'u aqli'ee Wa-gheedal maaa'u Wa-qudiyal amru wastawat 'alal joodiyyi Wa-qeela bu'dal lilqawmiz zaalimeen

45.t: Noah called out to his Lord, saying, “My Lord! Certainly my son is ˹also˺ of my family, Your promise is surely true, and You are the most just of all judges!”
45.tr: Wa naadaa noohur Rabbahoo faqaala Rabbi innabnee min ahlee Wa-inna wa'dakal haqqu Wa-Anta ahkamul haakimeen

46.t: Allah replied, “O Noah! He is certainly not of your family—he was entirely of unrighteous conduct. So do not ask Me about what you have no knowledge of! I warn you so you do not fall into ignorance.”
46.tr: Qaala yaa-Noohu innahoo laisa min ahlika innahoo 'amalun ghairu saalihin falaa tas'alni maa laisa laka bihee 'ilmun inneee a'izuka an takoona minal jaahileen

47.t: Noah pleaded, “My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking You about what I have no knowledge of, and unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be one of the losers.”
47.tr: Qaala rabbi inneee a'oozu bika an as'alaka maa laisa lee bihee 'ilmunw Wa-illaa taghfir lee Wa-tarhamneee akum minal khaasireen

48.t: It was said, “O Noah! Disembark with Our peace and blessings on you and some of the descendants of those with you. As for the others, We will allow them ˹a brief˺ enjoyment, then they will be touched with a painful punishment from Us.”
48.tr: Qeela yaa-Noohuh bit bisalaamim minnaa Wa-barakaatin 'alaika Wa-'alaaa umamim mimmam ma'ak; Wa-umamun sanumatti'uhum summa yamassuhum minaa 'azaabun aleem

49.t: This is one of the stories of the unseen, which we reveal to you ˹O Prophet˺. Neither you nor your people knew it before this. So be patient! Surely the ultimate outcome belongs ˹only˺ to the righteous
49.tr: Tilka min ambaaa'il ghaibi nooheehaaa ilaika maa kunta ta'lamuhaaaa anta Wa-laa qawmuka min qabli haazaa fasbir innal 'aaqibata lilmuttaqeen

50.t: And to the people of ’Âd We sent their brother Hûd. He said, “O my people! Worship Allah. You have no god other than Him. You do nothing but fabricate lies ˹against Allah˺
50.tr: Wa-ilaa 'aadin akhaahum Hoodaa; qaala yaa-qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhooo in antum illaa muftaroon

51.t: O my people! I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the One Who created me. Will you not then understand
51.tr: Yaa-qawmi laaa as'alukum 'alaihi ajran in ajriya illaa 'alal lazee fataranee; afalaa ta'qiloon

52.t: And O my people! Seek your Lord’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. He will shower you with rain in abundance, and add strength to your strength. So do not turn away, persisting in wickedness.”
52.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmis taghfiroo Rabbakum summa toobooo ilaihi yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaranw Wa-yazidkum quwwatan ilaa quwwatikum Wa-laa tatawallaw mujrimeen

53.t: They argued, “O Hûd! You have not given us any clear proof, and we will never abandon our gods upon your word, nor will we believe in you
53.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Hoodu maa ji'tanaa bibaiyinatinw Wa-maa nahnu bitaarikeee aalihatinaa 'an qawlika Wa-maa nahnu laka bimu'mineen

54.t: All we can say is that some of our gods have possessed you with evil.” He said, “I call Allah to witness, and you too bear witness, that I ˹totally˺ reject whatever you associate
54.tr: In naqoolu illa' taraaka ba'du aalihatinaa bisooo'; qaala inneee ushhidul laaha wash-hadooo annee bareee'um mimmaa tushrikoon

55.t: with Him ˹in worship˺. So let all of you plot against me without delay
55.tr: Min doonihee fakeedoonee jamee'an summa laa tunziroon

56.t: I have put my trust in Allah—my Lord and your Lord. There is no living creature that is not completely under His control. Surely my Lord’s Way is perfect justice
56.tr: Innee tawakkaltu 'alal laahi Rabbee Wa-Rabbikum; maa min daaabbatin illaa Huwa aakhizum binaasiyatihaa; inna Rabbee 'alaa Siraatim mustaqeem

57.t: But if you turn away, I have already delivered to you what I have been sent with. My Lord will replace you with others. You are not harming Him in the least. Indeed, my Lord is a ˹vigilant˺ Keeper over all things.”
57.tr: Fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum maaa ursiltu biheee ilaikum; Wa-yastakhlifu Rabbee qawman ghairakum Wa-laa tadur-roonahoo shai'aa; inna Rabbee 'alaa kulli shai'in Hafeez

58.t: When Our command came, We rescued Hûd and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us, saving them from a harsh torment
58.tr: Wa-lammaa jaaa'a amrunaa naj-jainaa Hoodanw wallazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa Wa-naj-jainaahum min 'azaabin ghaleez

59.t: That was ’Âd. They denied the signs of their Lord, disobeyed His messengers, and followed the command of every stubborn tyrant
59.tr: Wa-tilka 'aad, jahadoo bi-Aayaati Rabbihim Wa-'asaw Rusulahoo wattaba'ooo amra kulli jabbaarin 'aneed

60.t: They were followed by a curse in this world, as they will be on the Day of Judgment. Surely ’Âd denied their Lord. So away with ’Âd, the people of Hûd
60.tr: Wa-utbi'oo fee haazihid dunyaa la'natanw Wa-Yawmal Qiyaamah; alaaa inna 'Aadan kafaroo Rabbahum; alaa bu'dal li-'Aadin qawmin Hood

61.t: And to the people of Thamûd We sent their brother Ṣâliḥ. He said, “O my people! Worship Allah. You have no god other than Him. He ˹is the One Who˺ produced you from the earth and settled you on it. So seek His forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is Ever Near, All-Responsive ˹to prayers˺.”
61.tr: Wa-ilaa Samooda akhaahum Saalihaa; qaala yaa-qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahim ghairuhoo Huwa ansha-akum minal ardi wasta'-marakum feehaa fastaghfiroohu summa toobooo ilaih; inna Rabbee Qareebum Mujeeb

62.t: They argued, “O Ṣâliḥ! We truly had high hopes in you before this. How dare you forbid us to worship what our forefathers had worshipped? We are certainly in alarming doubt about what you are inviting us to.”
62.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Saalihu qad kunta feenaa marjuwwan qabla haazaaa atanhaanaaa an na'bu-da maa ya'budu aabaaa'unaa Wa-innanaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad'oonaaa ilaihi mureeb

63.t: He responded, “O my people! Consider if I stand on a clear proof from my Lord and He has blessed me with a mercy from Him. Who could help me against Allah if I were to disobey Him? You would only contribute to my doom
63.tr: Qaala yaa-qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alaa baiyinatim mir Rabbee Wa-aataanee minhu rahmatan famai yansurunee minal laahi in 'asaituhoo famaa tazeedoonanee ghaira takhseer

64.t: And O my people! This she-camel of Allah is a sign for you. So leave her to graze ˹freely˺ on Allah’s earth and do her no harm, or a swift punishment will overtake you!”
64.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi haazihee naaqatul laahi lakum aayatan fazaroohaa taakul feee ardil laahi Wa-laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa-yaakhuzakum azaabun qareeb

65.t: But they killed her, so he warned ˹them˺, “You have ˹only˺ three ˹more˺ days to enjoy life in your homes—this is an unfailing promise!”
65.tr: Fa-'aqaroohaa faqaala tamatta'oo fee daarikum salaasata aiy-yaamin zaalika wa'dun ghairu makzoob

66.t: When Our command came, We saved Ṣâliḥ and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us and spared them the disgrace of that Day. Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ is the All-Powerful, Almighty
66.tr: Falammaa jaaa'a amrunaa najjainaa Saalihanw wal-lazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa Wa-min khizyi Yawmi'iz inna Rabbaka Huwal Qawiyyul 'Azeez

67.t: And the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook the wrongdoers, so they fell lifeless in their homes
67.tr: Wa-akhazal lazeena zalamus saihatu fa-asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaasimeen

68.t: as if they had never lived there. Surely Thamûd denied their Lord, so away with Thamûd
68.tr: Ka-al lam yaghnaw feehaaa; alaaa inna Samooda kafaroo Rabbahum; alaa bu'dal li-Samood

69.t: And surely Our messenger-angels came to Abraham with good news ˹of a son˺. They greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” And he replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” Then it was not long before he brought ˹them˺ a ˹fat,˺ roasted calf
69.tr: Wa-laqad jaaa'at Rusulunaaa Ibraaheema bilbushraa qaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun famaa labisa an jaaa'a bi'ij-lin haneez

70.t: And when he saw that their hands did not reach for the food, he became suspicious and fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! We are ˹angels˺ sent ˹only˺ against the people of Lot.”
70.tr: Falammaa ra-aaa aidiyahum laa tasilu ilaihi nakirahum Wa-awjasa minhum kheefah; qaaloo laa takhaf innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmi Loot

71.t: And his wife was standing by, so she laughed, then We gave her good news of ˹the birth of˺ Isaac, and, after him, Jacob
71.tr: Wamra-atuhoo qaaa'imatun fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa bi-Iss-haaqa Wa-minw waraaa'i Iss-haaqa Ya'qoob

72.t: She wondered, “Oh, my! How can I have a child in this old age, and my husband here is an old man? This is truly an astonishing thing!”
72.tr: Qaalat yaa-wailataaa 'aalidu Wa-ana 'ajoozunw Wa-haaza ba'lee shaikhan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ajeeb

73.t: They responded, “Are you astonished by Allah’s decree? May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, O people of this house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.”
73.tr: Qaalooo ata'jabeena min amril laahi rahmatul laahi Wa-barakaatuhoo 'alaikum Ahlal Bayt; innahoo Hameedun Majeed

74.t: Then after the fear had left Abraham, and the good news had reached him, he began to plead with Us for the people of Lot
74.tr: Falammaa zahaba an Ibraaheemar raw'u Wa-jaaa'at hul-bushraaa yujaadilunaa fee qawmi Loot

75.t: Truly, Abraham was forbearing, tender-hearted, and ever turning ˹to his Lord˺

76.t: ˹The angels said,˺ “O Abraham! Plead no more! Your Lord’s decree has already come, and they will certainly be afflicted with a punishment that cannot be averted!”
76.tr: Yaaa-Ibraaheemu a'rid 'an haazaaa innahoo qad jaaa'a amru Rabbika Wa-innahum aateehim 'azaabun ghairun mardood

77.t: When Our messenger-angels came to Lot, he was distressed and worried by their arrival. He said, “This is a terrible day.”
77.tr: Wa-lammaa jaaa'at Rusulunaa Lootan seee'a bihim Wa-daaqa bihim zar'anw Wa-qaala haazaa yawmun 'aseeb

78.t: And ˹the men of˺ his people—who were used to shameful deeds—came to him rushing. He pleaded, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹for marriage˺—they are pure for you. So fear Allah, and do not humiliate me by disrespecting my guests. Is there not ˹even˺ a single right-minded man among you?”
78.tr: Wa-jaaa'ahoo qawmuhoo yuhra'oona ilaihi Wa-min qablu kaanoo ya'maloonas saiyyiaat; qaala yaa-qawmi haaa'ulaaa'i banaatee hunna atharu lakum fattaqul laaha Wa-laa tukhzooni fee daifee alaisa minkum rajulur rasheed

79.t: They argued, “You certainly know that we have no need for your daughters. You already know what we desire!”
79.tr: Qaaloo laqad 'alimta maa lanaa fee banaatika min haqq, Wa-innaka lata'lamu maa nureed

80.t: He responded, “If only I had the strength ˹to resist you˺ or could rely on a strong supporter.”
80.tr: Qaala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw aaweee ilaa ruknin shadeed

81.t: The angels said, “O Lot! We are the messengers of your Lord. They will never reach you. So travel with your family in the dark of night, and do not let any of you look back, except your wife. She will certainly suffer the fate of the others. Their appointed time is the morning. Is the morning not near?”
81.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Lootu innaa Rusulu Rabbika lain yasiloo ilaika fa-asri bi-ahlika biqit-'im minal laili Wa-laa yaltafit minkum ahadun illam ra-ataka innahoo museebuhaa maaa asaabahum; inna maw'i-dahumus subh; alaisas subhu biqareeb

82.t: When Our command came, We turned the cities upside down and rained down on them clustered stones of baked clay
82.tr: Falammaa jaaa'a amrunaa ja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa Wa-amtamaa 'alaihaa hijaaratam min sijjeelim mandood

83.t: marked by your Lord ˹O Prophet˺. And these stones are not far from the ˹pagan˺ wrongdoers
83.tr: Musawwamatan 'inda Rabbik; Wa-maa hiya minaz zaalimena biba'eed

84.t: And to the people of Midian We sent their brother Shu’aib. He said, “O my people! Worship Allah. You have no god other than Him. And do not give short measure and weight. I do see you in prosperity now, but I truly fear for you the torment of an overwhelming Day
84.tr: Wa-ilaa Madyana akhaahum Shu'aibaa; qaala yaa-qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo Wa-laa tanqusul mikyaala walmeezaan; inneee araakum bikhairinw Wa-innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmim muheet

85.t: O my people! Give full measure and weigh with justice. Do not defraud people of their property, nor go about spreading corruption in the land
85.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi awful mikyaala walmeezaana bilqisti Wa-laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa'ahum Wa-laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

86.t: What is left ˹as a lawful gain˺ by Allah is far better for you if you are ˹truly˺ believers. And I am not a keeper over you.”
86.tr: Baqiyyatul laahi khairul lakum in kuntum mu'mineen; Wa-maa ana 'alaikum bihafeez

87.t: They asked ˹sarcastically˺, “O Shu’aib! Does your prayer command you that we should abandon what our forefathers worshipped or give up managing our wealth as we please? Indeed, you are such a tolerant, sensible man!”
87.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Shu'aybu 'a-salaatuka ta'muruka an natruka maa ya'budu aabaaa'unaaa aw an naf'ala feee amwaalinaa maa nashaaa'oo innaka la-antal haleemur rasheed

88.t: He said, “O my people! Consider if I stand on a clear proof from my Lord and He has blessed me with a good provision from Him. I do not want to do what I am forbidding you from. I only intend reform to the best of my ability. My success comes only through Allah. In Him I trust and to Him I turn
88.tr: Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aitum in kuntu 'alaa baiyinatim mir Rabbee Wa-razaqanee minhu rizqan hasanaa; Wa-maaa ureedu an ukhaalifakum ilaa maaa anhaakum 'anh; in ureedu illal islaaha mastata't; Wa-maa tawfeeqeee illaa billaah; 'alaihi tawakkaltu Wa-ilaihi uneeb

89.t: O my people! Do not let your opposition to me lead you to a fate similar to that of the people of Noah, or Hûd, or Ṣâliḥ. And the people of Lot are not far from you
89.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi laa yajri-mannakum shiqaaqeee aien yuseebakum mislu maaa asaaba qawma Noohin aw qawma Hoodin aw qawma Saalih; Wa-maa qawmu Lootim minkum biba'eed

90.t: So seek your Lord’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is Most Merciful, All-Loving.”
90.tr: Wastaghfiroo Rabbakum summa toobooo ilaih; inna Rabbee Raheemunw Wadood

91.t: They threatened, “O Shu’aib! We do not comprehend much of what you say, and surely we see you powerless among us. Were it not for your clan, we would have certainly stoned you, for you are nothing to us.”
91.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Shu'aibu maa nafqahu kaseeram mimmaa taqoolu Wa-innaa lanaraaka feenaa da'eefanw Wa-law-laa rahtuka larajamnaaka Wa-maaa anta 'alainaa bi'azeez

92.t: He said, “O my people! Do you have more regard for my clan than for Allah, turning your back on Him entirely? Surely my Lord is Fully Aware of what you do
92.tr: Qaala yaa-qawmi arahteee a'azzu 'alaikum minal laahi wattakhaztumoohu waraaa'akum zihriyyan inna Rabbee bimaa ta'maloona muheet

93.t: O my people! Persist in your ways, for I ˹too˺ will persist in mine. You will soon come to know who will be visited by a humiliating torment and is a liar! And watch! I too am watching with you!”
93.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi' maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamilun sawfa ta'lamoona many ya'teehi 'azaabuny yukhzeehi Wa-man huwa kaazib; wartaqibooo innnee ma'akum raqeeb

94.t: When Our command came, We saved Shu’aib and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us. And the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook the wrongdoers, so they fell lifeless in their homes
94.tr: Wa-lammaa jaaa'a amrunaa najjainaa shu'aibanw wal-lazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa Wa-akhazatil lazeena zalamus saihatu fa-asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaasimeen

95.t: as if they had never lived there. So away with Midian as it was with Thamûd
95.tr: Ka-al lam yaghnaw feehaaa; alaa bu'dal li-Madyana Kamaa ba'idat Samood

96.t: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs and compelling proof
96.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi-Aayaatinaa Wa-sultaanim mubeen

97.t: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh’s command was not well guided
97.tr: Ilaa Fir'awna Wa-mala'ihee fattaba'ooo amra Fir'awna Wa-maaa amru Fir'awna birasheed

98.t: He will be before his people on the Day of Judgment and will lead them into the Fire. What an evil place to be led into
98.tr: Yaqdumu qawmahoo Yawmal Qiyaamati fa-awrada-humun Naara Wa-bi'sal wirdul mawrood

99.t: They were followed by a curse in this ˹life˺ and ˹will receive another˺ on the Day of Judgment. What an evil gift to receive
99.tr: Wa-utbi'oo fee haazihee la'natanw Wa-Yawmal Qiyaamah; bi'sar rifdul marfood

100.t: These are accounts, We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺, of the ˹destroyed˺ cities. Some are still standing ˹barren˺, while others have been mowed down
100.tr: Zaalika min ambaaa'il quraa naqussuhoo 'alaika minhaa qaaa'imunw Wa-haseed

101.t: We did not wrong them, rather they wronged themselves. The gods they invoked beside Allah were of no help at all when the command of your Lord came, and only contributed to their ruin
101.tr: Wa-maa zalamnaahum Wa-laakin zalamooo anfusahum famaaa aghnat 'anhum aalihatuhumul latee yad'oona min doonil laahi min shai'il lammaa jaaa'a amru Rabbika Wa-maa zaadoohum ghaira tatbeeb

102.t: Such is the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord when He seizes the societies entrenched in wrongdoing. Indeed, His grip is ˹terribly˺ painful and severe
102.tr: Wa-kazaalika akhzu Rabbika izaaa akhazal quraa Wa-hiya zaalimah; inna akhzahooo aleemun shadeed

103.t: Surely in this is a sign for those who fear the torment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which humanity will be gathered and a Day ˹that will be˺ witnessed ˹by all˺
103.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-aayatal liman khaafa 'azaabal Aakhirah; zaalika Yawmum majmoo'ul lahun naasu Wa-zaalika Yawmum mashhood

104.t: We only delay it for a fixed term

105.t: When that Day arrives, no one will dare speak except with His permission. Some of them will be miserable, others joyful
105.tr: Yawma yaati laa takallamu nafsun illaa bi-iznih; faminhum shaqiyyunw Wa-sa'eed

106.t: As for those bound for misery, they will be in the Fire, where they will be sighing and gasping
106.tr: Fa-ammal lazeena shaqoo fafin Naari lahum feehaa zafeerunw Wa-shaheeq

107.t: staying there forever, as long as the heavens and the earth will endure, except what your Lord wills. Surely your Lord does what He intends
107.tr: Khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaaa'a Rabbuk; inna Rabbaka fa'-'aalul limaa yureed

108.t: And as for those destined to joy, they will be in Paradise, staying there forever, as long as the heavens and the earth will endure, except what your Lord wills—a ˹generous˺ giving, without end
108.tr: Wa-ammal lazeena su'idoo fafil Jannati khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaaa'a Rabbuk; ataaa'an ghaira majzooz

109.t: So do not be in doubt ˹O Prophet˺ about what those ˹pagans˺ worship. They worship nothing except what their forefathers worshipped before ˹them˺. And We will certainly give them their share ˹of punishment˺ in full, without any reduction
109.tr: Falaa taku fee miryatim mimmmaa ya'budu haaa'ulaaa'; maa ya'budoona illaa kamaa ya'budu aabaaa'uhum min qabl; Wa-innaa lamuwaf-foohum naseebahum ghaira manqoos

110.t: Indeed, We had given Moses the Scripture, but differences arose regarding it. Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord, their differences would have been settled ˹at once˺. They are truly in alarming doubt about it
110.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba fakhtulifa feeh; Wa-law-laa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika laqudiya bainahum; Wa-innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb

111.t: And surely your Lord will fully pay all for their deeds. He is certainly All-Aware of what they do
111.tr: Wa-inna kullal lammaa la-yuwaffiyannahum Rabbuka a'maalahum; innahoo bimaa ya'maloona Khabeer

112.t: So be steadfast as you are commanded ˹O Prophet˺, along with those who turn ˹in submission to Allah˺ with you. And do not transgress. Surely He is All-Seeing of what you ˹believers˺ do
112.tr: Fastaqim kamaaa umirta Wa-man taaba ma'aka Wa-laa tatghaw; innahoo bimaa ta'maloona Baseer

113.t: And do not be inclined to the wrongdoers or you will be touched by the Fire. For then you would have no protectors other than Allah, nor would you be helped
113.tr: Wa-laa tarkanooo ilal lazeena zalamoo fatamassa-kumun Naaru Wa-maa lakum min doonil laahi min awliyaaa'a summa laa tunsaroon

114.t: Establish prayer ˹O Prophet˺ at both ends of the day and in the early part of the night. Surely good deeds wipe out evil deeds. That is a reminder for the mindful
114.tr: Wa-aqimis Salaata tarafayin nahaari Wa-zulafam minal layl; innal hasanaati yuzhibnas saiyi-aat; zaalika zikraa liz-zaakireen

115.t: And be patient! Certainly Allah does not discount the reward of the good-doers
115.tr: Wasbir fa-innal laaha laa yudee'u ajral muhsineen

116.t: If only there had been among the ˹destroyed˺ peoples before you, ˹O believers,˺ virtuous individuals who forbade corruption in the land—other than the few We had saved ˹from the torment˺. But the wrongdoers ˹only˺ pursued their ˹worldly˺ pleasures, becoming wicked
116.tr: Falaw-laa kaana minal qurooni min qablikum ooloo baqiyyatiny yanhawna 'anil fasaadi fil ardi illaa qaleelam mimman anjainaa minhum; wattaba'al lazeena zalamoo maaa utrifoo feehi Wa-kaanoo mujrimeen

117.t: And your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ would never destroy a society unjustly while its people were acting rightly
117.tr: Wa-maa kaana Rabbuka liyuhlikal quraa bizulminw Wa-ahluhaa muslihoon

118.t: Had your Lord so willed, He would have certainly made humanity one single community ˹of believers˺, but they will always ˹choose to˺ differ—
118.tr: Wa-law shaaa'a Rabbuka laja'al annnaasa ummatanw waa-hidatanw Wa-laa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen

119.t: except those shown mercy by your Lord—and so He created them ˹to choose freely˺. And so the Word of your Lord will be fulfilled: “I will surely fill up Hell with jinn and humans all together.”
119.tr: Illaa mar rahima Rabbuk; Wa-lizaalika khalaqahum; Wa-tammat Kalimatu Rabbika la-amla'ana Jahannama minal jinnati wannnaasi ajma'een

120.t: And We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ the stories of the messengers to reassure your heart. And there has come to you in this ˹sûrah˺ the truth, a warning ˹to the disbelievers˺, and a reminder to the believers
120.tr: Wa-kullan naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'ir Rusuli maa nusabbitu bihee fu'aadak; Wa-jaaa'aka fee haazihil haqqu Wa-maw'izatunw Wa-zikraa lilmu'-mineen

121.t: Say to those who disbelieve, “Persist in your ways; we will certainly persist in ours
121.tr: Wa-qul lillazeena laa yu'minoo na'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innaa 'aamiloon

122.t: And wait! Surely we ˹too˺ are waiting.”

123.t: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the knowledge of what is hidden in the heavens and the earth. And to Him all matters are returned. So worship Him and put your trust in Him. And your Lord is never unaware of what you do
123.tr: Wa-lillaahi ghaibus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-ilaihi yurja'ul amru kulluhoo fa'bud-hu Wa-tawakkal 'alaih; Wa-maa Rabbuka bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
